text:
mike: Heads up — snack cabinet is down to 2 granola bars and no oat milk. Anyone headed to the store?

maria: I can swing by after standup (around 11:30). any preferences for granola brand? gluten-free options?

sam: Please get the gluten-free ones if available. Also more instant coffee pods? The stash is almost gone. ☕️

jordan: OMG the snack mix debate starts again. salty vs sweet? i vote salty (pretzels + nuts). :raised_hands:

mike: salty for morning, sweet for 3pm. compromise: one container of each?

alex: If someone buys almond/oat milk, can we label fridge with a name/date? Last time it disappeared. 😂
maria: good call. i'll bring a sheet of masking tape and a black marker.

kitchen-bot: Reminder: Office kitchen supplies budget limit is $45/week. Submit receipts to #finance-submissions. :robot_face:

sam: FYI — i'm allergic to tree nuts, would appreciate the nut-free snack option (rice crackers or popcorn).
jordan: noted. i'll bring a sealed bag of popcorn if maria can't find nut-free granola.
mike: Maria — if you want a shopping list: `granola (GF)`, `instant coffee pods (medium)`, `oat milk x2`, `almond milk x1`, `assorted snack mix (sweet & salty)`, `popcorn (nut-free)`
maria: Got it. i'll aim for the store run. total should be under budget. anyone want me to grab anything else?
alex: Can we have a simple coffee pot protocol posted on the fridge? Quick one-liner: empty carafe -> rinse -> fill -> brew. So many messy mornings. :pray:
mike: YES. maybe use this block for the fridge sign:
```
Coffee pot protocol:
1) If the carafe is empty, rinse and fill with fresh water.
2) Grind/brew only once for the batch size shown.
3) Label any opened milk with name & date.
4) If you finish the last pod/pack, replace it or add to the shopping list.
```
maria: i'll stick that on the fridge and bring tape. also i'll post the receipt in #finance-submissions when i get back. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
kitchen-bot: Inventory update scheduled: next run 1769090000.
